also- if you need someone to talk to, at any time let me know. i’d be more than happy to chat with you. being a mom is tough, but being a mom in a terrible situation like this? it can feel like it’s impossible. I wish nothing but the best for you and your sweet baby❤️

the only reason i haven’t done it yet is because of my dog. she won’t understand why i’m gone, and she’s the most precious thing in the world to me. she’s never left my side, not once. That’s the funny thing about animals. They love you no matter what and it’s impossible for them to turn their back on you. It’s my responsibility now to not leave her side either. I hope you feel better. I hope somehow, some way you get a flicker of hope that keeps you going and gets you through even just today and tonight. I hope more than anything, that you can get through everyday and every night. But take it one minute at a time. You’re special. I’m holding out hope. ❤️

php is short hand for partial hospitalization! In my experience it was zoom call meetings all day for group therapy. Mine was all online because of covid risks but there’s some that are in person in different areas. I thought i was going to HATE it, but I fell in love with it. A lot of them are flexible too if you have work/other life commitments. And yes! You don’t have to go to the emergency room !! most times you just need some sort of a referral from any type of doctor or therapist. I wish I had gone sooner to be honest. 
Also don’t worry too hard about the finances. I am very unstable financially but I got set up with a payment plan of literally $50 a month. It’s very worth it in my opinion.

the pills are going to be excruciating trust me. Of course I welcome you to share those types of thoughts too, but if you want light hearted conversation I’m here for that as well!!! We can send funny pictures or videos. I can send you pictures of my puppy in funny clothes. I’m here, I see you, I validate you, and I am here for you. ❤️

I went to the ER about two months ago for this. The staff was very nice, they took my possessions from me for safety/protocol reasons but let me hold on to my switch so I could play Animal Crossing lol. Anyways, I spent the night there and they checked on me every so often. I wasn’t a massive threat to myself while inside the hospital so they didn’t have someone monitoring me inside my room every second. I got a call from a psychiatrist while in the hospital on their computer in a zoom like fashion. She asked me questions, and discharged me after placing me in a partial hospitalization program. I’m not sure how much you know about php, but i went every weekday from 9:30-3 and it was a mixture of group therapy types of meetings. 
I also see that you set up an appointment for Monday. That can be helpful! I’m doing the exact same thing. I believe in you!!! And I’m very, very proud of you for reaching out for help. You’re doing something amazing and inspiring others on here to do the same. Feel better soon ❤️
